title: pinus tabuliformis subsp. umbraculifera
intro: Pinus tabuliformis subsp. umbraculifera, commonly known as Chinese Umbrella Pine, is a subspecies of evergreen coniferous tree native to the mountainous regions of northern China. This plant is valued for its traditional use in Chinese medicine, where it is believed to possess various health benefits, including reducing fever, alleviating cough and respiratory issues, and acting as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Chinese Umbrella Pine include its antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes. The bioactive constituents of Chinese Umbrella Pine also exhibit neuroprotective and immune-boosting effects, further solidifying its potential as a medicinal plant.
